essential_open_obligations: Physical Hill spectrum and Birkhoff map.
Endpoint spectral estimates and inverse regularity needed by 1.4.
Actual KdV H^-1 smooth-approximation solution extension, invariance and continuity.
Wiener Birkhoff diffeomorphism and actual KdV analytic trajectory map.
no_completion_claim: The generic frequency functional Ω is arbitrary and is not asserted to be a constructed KdV frequency. Conditional continuity of realized frequencies is an explicit generic theorem hypothesis, never a substitute for proving that hypothesis for KdV.
